item.title: Rajasthan High Court Protects Young Couple’s Right to Live-in Relationship Despite Family Threats and Legal Age Objections
item.description: Kota couple’s live-in relationship receives court protection against family threats, affirming personal liberty beyond marriage age restrictions.

item.title: People of Purpose: How Komal Ganotra’s Two-Decade Journey in Child Rights Led to Creating Safetitude
item.description: A journey of relentless commitment, Komal Ganotra bridges grassroots activism and policy reform to safeguard children and communities.

item.title: Trump Warns India Against Dumping Cheap Rice, Signals Fresh Tariffs to Shield US Farmers from Price Crash
item.description: U.S. President Trump threatens escalated tariffs on Indian basmati and non-basmati rice imports, accusing exporters of undercutting American farmers amid $12 billion in federal aid.

item.title: 22-Year-Old Indian Student’s Suicidal Abuse by UK Labour Councillor Hina Mir Triggers £40,000 Fine
item.description: 22-year-old Indian student endured 24/7 illegal nanny abuse and suicidal thoughts by UK Labour councillor Hina Mir, fined £40,000.

item.title: Pawan Singh Files Complaint After Threats From Bishnoi Gang Over Sharing Stage With Salman Khan: Reports
item.description: Pawan Singh reportedly receives Bishnoi gang extortion threats over Salman Khan Bigg Boss 19 finale performance.

item.title: Magnitude 7.5 Quake Hits Northern Japan; Thousands Evacuate as Tsunami Threat Quickly Passes
item.description: A 7.5-magnitude quake off Aomori injured 30, prompted 90,000 evacuations, and saw quick tsunami alert lift with no fatalities.

item.title: Russia Suspends Flights at Four Airports, Warns Residents Amid Regional Drone Attack Alerts: Report
item.description: Russian authorities halted operations at four airports following drone threat alerts: Reports.

item.title: China Warns US Over Taiwan After Trump’s Security Strategy; Tensions Rise as Taipei Welcomes The Plan
item.description: China rebuked the US's new National Security Strategy bolstering Taiwan's defences, as Beijing vows to defend its sovereignty claims amid rising Indo-Pacific tensions.

item.description: Lakhs of candidates anticipate the SSC CGL Tier 1 Result 2025 on ssc.gov.in, unlocking paths to government jobs.

item.title: Historic Triumph: India’s L Keerthana Wins Triple Gold at Carrom World Cup 2025 in Maldives
item.description: Tamil Nadu's L Keerthana secured gold in singles, doubles, and team at the 7th Carrom World Cup in Maldives.
